sentences.text: At Middleton is a 2013 American romantic comedy film directed by Adam Rodgers and starring Andy García , Vera Farmiga , Taissa Farmiga , and Spencer Lofranco .	Andy García	Andy García	Vera Farmiga	Vera Farmiga	Taissa Farmiga	Taissa Farmiga	Spencer Lofranco	Spencer Lofranco	romantic comedy	romantic comedy
Written by Glenn German and Adam Rodgers , the film follows a man and a woman as they meet and fall in love while taking their children on a college tour .

The film had its world premiere at the Seattle International Film Festival on May 17 , 2013 .	Seattle	Seattle International Film Festival	Seattle International Film Festival	Seattle International Film Festival
